Opereka

Zamtel
Mobile · no per-operator subscriber count published
Mobile & Fixed. 100% Government of Zambia owned (reacquired 2012 after a reversed fraudulent 2010 sale to Libya's LAP Green Networks). Also Zambia's sole fixed-line operator (~80,000 lines) — grouped here under Mobile since ZICTA reports it as one of the three national mobile network operators; see note for its fixed-line role. ZICTA does not publish per-operator subscriber figures.
Perekani gawo pa imelo →
MTN Zambia
Mobile · no per-operator subscriber count published
Subsidiary of MTN Group (South Africa); some free-float shares trade on the Lusaka Securities Exchange. ZICTA does not publish per-operator subscriber figures.
Perekani gawo pa imelo →
Airtel Zambia
Mobile · no per-operator subscriber count published
Subsidiary of Airtel Africa plc, majority-owned by Bharti Airtel (India). ZICTA does not publish per-operator subscriber figures.
Perekani gawo pa imelo →
Liquid Intelligent Technologies Zambia
Fixed/Wireless · no subscriber count published
Fixed/Fibre. Subsidiary of Cassava Technologies (Strive Masiyiwa's pan-African group). Operates national fiber backbone, wholesale capacity and public Wi-Fi. No subscriber count published.
Perekani gawo pa imelo →
Paratus Zambia
Fixed/Wireless · no subscriber count published
Fixed/Fibre & Fixed Wireless. Part of Paratus Group (Namibia-headquartered, linked to Namibia's Capricorn Group). Offers fiber, fixed wireless, satellite and enterprise connectivity. No subscriber count published.
Perekani gawo pa imelo →
Zamnet
Fixed/Wireless · no subscriber count published
Fixed/Fibre & ISP services. Zambia's original ISP (historically dial-up, now broader fixed/fibre and ISP services). Current ownership/status could not be confirmed in research for this build — flagged honestly rather than guessed.
Perekani gawo pa imelo →
